brief: We are returning your issued inverter-successor-review.zip for a new revision. Please issue one ZIP our buyer can use unchanged for five complete assembled low-voltage bench inverter prototypes from JLCPCB. Process: two-layer FR-4, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, lead-free HASL, ordinary tented vias, no filled/capped vias or special via-in-pad treatment; Standard PCBA with top-side SMT and supplier-installed connectors, including through-hole assembly if used. Supplier-added rails, fiducials and tooling are acceptable as standard order selections. The editable project must work on a different stock KiCad 9 installation. Keep the 5 W source/load conditions and distinguish design from measurement. The previous issue is unpacked byte-for-byte at previous-issue/. Our measured supplier return is in shop-return/ and original supplier documentation and component-specific reference data are in supply-reference/. R4 was on your board but missing from the schematic; two connector library footprints disagreed with the board; six 0.30 mm holes were inside U1's solder-paste opening. The published land patterns and supplier placement rows also raised orientation and origin questions. We need actual order files and clear recipient instructions, without a buyer correcting CAD, selecting parts, or adjusting placement. How you design, collaborate, verify, and decide when to issue is up to you. If a blocker remains, issue the best supported revision and identify it precisely. No upload, order, payment, physical build or follow-up from the shop.
receiver_template: Act as our independent receiving shop for the exact released edition {edition}. Can the buyer use its unedited download to order five complete assembled 5 W low-voltage bench inverter prototypes from JLCPCB? Specified order: two-layer FR-4, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, lead-free HASL, ordinary tented vias, no filled/capped vias or special via-in-pad; Standard PCBA, top SMT and supplier-installed connectors. Supplier-added rails, fiducials and tooling are acceptable order selections. Please inspect what actually arrived against JLCPCB part and placement data, relocated schematic-to-board parity and this process. Your working folder contains supplier reference material; the separate receiving toolchain has stock KiCad 9, python3, and a read-only supplier reference at /tmp/opencode/revision-counter/reference. Decide how to check and give the buyer your supported verdict on the exact edition. No editing the supplier files, contacting the designer for repairs, upload, order, payment or physical build.
method: One new engineering request to the continuing issuer, not another arm of the prior comparison. Invite Arden alone through packaged Studio with the saved medium gpt-6.1-sol Codex OAuth configuration. Supply the actual previous edition, measurements, immutable catalog, public part-specific library records and public supplier process documentation, not corrected sources or a design solution. No prompt to revise character parameters. Withhold all online shop submission and designer follow-up. Observe natural stopping/waiting/hold; at the bound close admissions and report censoring. Score the last actual ZIP at that boundary.
independent_receiving: After the engineering boundary, make a new receiving workspace from that stopped history with no designer working files; the chosen receiver must not have participated in this engineering activity. Invite them once in a separate Studio activity. They get the exact edition address and published reference material, not the predecessor's shop return or our scoring results. Check the issue's identity, the provider receipts, and whether their selected toolchain and staged bytes actually support their verdict. If there is no revision to receive, record the missing handoff.
operator_verification: Separately export the exact original ZIP, compare its SHA-256 to the native download, and work on a relocated copy with the designer's installation and project unreadable. Check every fitted designator, order identity, stock/allowance, supplier side/XY/rotation, polarity, connector fit and process against public sources. A library footprint is a geometric reference, not a factory machine-zero guarantee. Regenerate ERC, ordinary DRC, strict parity, netlist, Gerbers and drill; cross-read copper/paste/mask, holes, editable circuit and order instructions. Score digital use, unresolved assumptions, actual factory acceptance and measured performance separately. No repeated commission to obtain a pass.
